scope: Six natural public-input GameSession runs from one frozen production simulation bundle. No browser,performance,memory or human-fun acceptance.
assertionPolicy: No forced win,damage,synergy or kill count. Real failures,stalls and measurement errors remain in raw per-run files.
mutationScope: Only GameSession.start/step/chooseDraft/chooseCombatUpgrade/cancelResearch/resume. No HP,position,time,wave,target,world or equipment-state injection.

strategy.shooting: Precision primary;AOE only with4 nearby enemies;normal threat evasion,Q and repair as needed.
strategy.area: Always use ready tool2,fill gaps with precision;prioritize nova/haste/power;normal threat evasion,Q and repair.
strategy.immune: Prioritize immune/scan;Q toward enemies whenever ready;beacon+trace protocol route;cover threats,let active reachable cells finish remote fodder.
strategy.shared: Reads visible footprints/current frozen telegraphs;normal WASD navigation,space dash,Q/2/3/E as needed;every pending modal uses public selection APIs with replacement confirmation.
